claims.text: Postpartum timing: contact with a maternal care provider within the first 3 weeks postpartum, then ongoing care as needed, with a comprehensive postpartum visit no later than 12 weeks after birth.
claims.quote: All women should ideally have contact with a maternal care provider within the first 3 weeks postpartum. This initial assessment should be followed up with ongoing care as needed, concluding with a comprehensive postpartum visit no later than 12 weeks after birth.

claims.text: Comprehensive postpartum visit: mood and emotional well-being; infant care and feeding; sexuality, contraception and birth spacing; sleep and fatigue; physical recovery from birth; chronic disease management; health maintenance.
claims.quote: The comprehensive postpartum visit should include a full assessment of physical, social, and psychological well-being, including the following domains: mood and emotional well-being; infant care and feeding; sexuality, contraception, and birth spacing; sleep and fatigue; physical recovery from birth; chronic disease management; and health maintenance.
